subject: Multi-cloud SKU localization & packaging: proposed slices for AWS/Azure/GCP
messages:
From: Susan Li <susan.li@cloudco-gcp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@aws-partner.com>, procurement@contoso.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Initial scoping: Contoso co-sell + marketplace packaging

Hi Vivek —

Great to connect last week. Contoso procurement asked us to produce a simple, region-aware packaging proposal for the three cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP) that lines up with their buying zones and our co-sell expectations. They want a tight mapping: which SKUs to publish per cloud/region, suggested bundles (entry vs enterprise), and any premium/reserved options.

I attached a first-pass SKU_slice_v1.xlsx with our suggested slices (region columns + cloud-specific SKU ids). Can your team: (1) review the recommended SKU splits for US regions, (2) flag any compliance/availability constraints for Private deployments, and (3) confirm the co-sell checklist items AWS will require?

Ideal timeline: confirmation by Wed 22 Apr so Contoso can kick procurement.

Thanks,
Susan
GCP Partner Lead — CloudCo
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Li <susan.li@cloudco-gcp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial scoping: Contoso co-sell + marketplace packaging

Susan — thanks for the file and the ask. Quick notes up front:

- We'll validate the SKU slice for US-East/West and add a Canada split (Contoso asked for CA on the call).
- Azure has one pricing tier that will not map cleanly to our smallest entry bundle due to VM family availability in US Gov; Karthik will annotate.
- I'll run the SKU file through Product to ensure model variants (quantized vs fp16) are labeled — that affects pricing buckets.

Laura / Karthik, assigning initial review. Expect a deliverable with redlines and a short decision table by EOD Tue.

Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Li <susan.li@cloudco-gcp.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial scoping: Contoso co-sell + marketplace packaging

On Tue, Apr 20, 2026 at 09:14 AM Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> Laura / Karthik, assigning initial review. Expect a deliverable with redlines and a short decision table by EOD Tue.

Quick scan attached — I added an "availability" column for each cloud/region and a suggested mapping column where the SKU granularity differs. Key calls:

- AWS: publish three SKUs (entry, standard, reserved-enterprise). Use reserved-enterprise for Dedicated only; do not advertise it for hosted plans.
- Azure: US Gov requires a separate SKU (gov-us) — move Contoso's Gov workloads to the gov-us SKU and mark as "private deployment only". See pricing_delta_azure.pdf for expected delta.
- GCP: can reuse the standard SKU but recommend a region tag to reduce latency for Contoso's west-coast users.

Attachments: SKU_slice_v1.xlsx (redlines), pricing_delta_azure.pdf

Questions for Vivek/Susan: do we want the same feature parity across entry SKUs on all clouds, or keep features gated (e.g., prefix caching) for higher tiers to encourage upgrade?

- Karthik
Product Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Li <susan.li@cloudco-gcp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial scoping: Contoso co-sell + marketplace packaging

Thanks — I reviewed the redlines. High-level decision recommendations:

- Keep entry SKUs feature-light and identical across clouds to simplify Contoso's procurement (same billable features: tokens, basic embeddings).
- Standard SKU should include smarter batching presets and a small KV cache allowance; available in all public regions.
- Reserved-enterprise SKU: Dedicated only, includes extended support, guaranteed throughput SLAs and optional on-prem package (listed as a separate add-on SKU).

Operational notes for Marketplace teams: we need three separate listings per cloud for legal/terms clarity (explicitly call out Dedicated vs Hosted). Marissa, can you confirm the required doc set for AWS co-sell? I suspect we'll need the aws_co-sell_checklist.docx updates.

Laura
Head of Product — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Li <susan.li@cloudco-gcp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial scoping: Contoso co-sell + marketplace packaging

Laura — acknowledge. I updated the checklist and attached aws_co-sell_checklist.docx with the specific deliverables (SLA addendum, security attestation, product screenshots, install guide for private). For Contoso procurement: we should include a note about regional availability windows (some AZs take up to 6 weeks for private onboarding).

Susan / Contoso procurement: if that timeline works, we can target publishing standard + entry SKUs to AWS/Azure/GCP within 3 weeks of contract signature, and Reserved-enterprise 4–6 weeks (Dedicated capacity provisioning).

Marissa
Marketplace Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Li <susan.li@cloudco-gcp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial scoping: Contoso co-sell + marketplace packaging

All — thanks for the quick turn. Agreed on the three-listing approach. Final decisions:

1) Publish: entry, standard, reserved-enterprise per cloud (reserved listed as Dedicated-only).
2) Feature parity: entry SKUs identical across clouds; standard includes batching + small KV cache across clouds.
3) Azure Gov: special gov-us SKU, private-only.
4) Timeline: target publish of entry+standard in 3 weeks post-signature; reserved-enterprise to follow after Dedicated capacity provisioning.

Susan — can you confirm Contoso is comfortable with the CA inclusion and the expected provisioning windows? If yes, I'll circulate a short MOU and a HubSpot deal update.

Vivek
From: Susan Li <susan.li@cloudco-gcp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@contoso.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial scoping: Contoso co-sell + marketplace packaging

Vivek — confirmed on CA and timelines. Contoso procurement accepts the 3-week/6-week split. Please send the MOU and HubSpot update; procurement will open a purchase order once the entry+standard listings are live in AWS/Azure/GCP.

Best,
Susan
